title: Sudo Execution of Account and Credential Utilities
Linux Find Command Enumerating SUID, SGID, or Sticky Bit Files
expression: contains(to_string(process.args), 'find') && contains(to_string(process.args), '-perm') && (contains(to_string(process.args), '-1000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '/1000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '1000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '01000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '-2000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '/2000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '2000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '02000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '-4000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '/4000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '4000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '04000') || contains(to_string(process.args), '-g=s') || contains(to_string(process.args), 'g=s') || contains(to_string(process.args), '-u=s') || contains(to_string(process.args), 'u=s'))

title: Suspicious JSP File Creation or Modification in Web-Accessible Directory
expression: (to_string(event.action) == 'created' || to_string(event.action) == 'modified' || to_string(event.action) == 'renamed') && ends_with(to_string(file.path), '.jsp') && (contains(to_string(file.path), 'tmp') || contains(to_string(file.path), 'upload') || contains(to_string(file.path), 'uploads') || contains(to_string(file.path), 'files') || contains(to_string(file.path), 'images') || contains(to_string(file.path), 'public'))
